title: Hands-on Lab: Environment Setup, CLI, and Developer Workflow
instructions: Create a new project, install Express and Nodemon, create an `index.js` that starts a server on port 4000, and add `"dev": "nodemon index.js"` to scripts. Run `npm run dev` and verify the server starts. Change the response message, save, and verify Nodemon restarted automatically.
solution_code:
mkdir eth-aifs-demo && cd eth-aifs-demo
npm init -y
npm install express cors dotenv
npm install --save-dev nodemon
